newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN LEU ENDS FLAT ON DULL MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN LEU ENDS FLAT ON DULL MARKET.

text.p: 1400GMT - The Romanian leu currency closed Wednesday at 7,090/7,100 to the dollar, almost unchanged from opening, in quiet interbank trading, operators said.
* A few players bought several million dollars in early trading, causing the leu to dip slightly, but afterwards trading was dull on a liquid interbank market, traders said.
* They said the leu would stay close to Wednesday's level after Labour Day on May 1, when the domestic foreign exchange market is closed.
* The central bank was expected to continue to purchase dollars to prevent the leu from firming.
* Money market rates clung to around 105 percent.
* Latest central bank data put interbank volume at $22.3 million on Tuesday, when overall trading was $35.0 million.
* Leu-dollar retail rates lingered at about 6,750/6,950.
